g.text: From token IDs to next-token logits
Full forward dependencies | read each lane top to bottom; inference scheduling is shown separately
2 Q = U Wq | K = U Wk | V = U Wv
Split into heads; RoPE on Q and K
Each layer has its own Q/K/V projections and KV cache.
The FFN output becomes the next layer's input.
Final RMSNorm → LM head → token selection
Next generation step: look up that ID's embedding
SELF BLOCK × 6 · each has its own state
Read qS → head norm / gate → Wout
CROSS BLOCK × 6 · each has its own Q
Input C0 = H6; then previous cross output
and new FFN at each layer.
Training: next-token loss at every valid position
Blue / teal: hidden-state path Purple: shared memory Orange dashed: optional fusion ×N: sequential blocks
